items.title: Michael Polansky is training an AI model on skin that’s still alive
items.title_cn: 迈克尔·波兰斯基（ Michael Polansky ）正在为活着的皮肤训练人工智能模型
items.summary: Michael Polansky — better known publicly as Lady Gaga's partner and a former top deputy to Sean Parker — has quietly spent years building an AI-driven startup that keeps living human skin tissue alive for weeks outside the body to discover new skincare compounds, and is only now going public about it.
items.summary_cn: 迈克尔·波兰斯基（ Michael Polansky ） --众所周知是Lady Gaga的合伙人，也是肖恩·帕克（ Sean Parker ）的前高级副手--悄悄地花了数年时间建立了一家人工智能驱动的初创公司，让活体人体皮肤组织在体外存活数周，以发现新的护肤化合物，现在才公开。
items.comment: 新模型来了，是骡子是马拉出来遛遛，别光看宣传看实测。

items.title: Japanese space tech startup Letara expands beyond satellite thrusters with $16M
items.title_cn: 日本太空科技创业公司Letara以1600万美元的价格超越卫星推进器
items.summary: Japanese space startup Letara is betting its hybrid rocket technology can move beyond small satellite thrusters into a broader market for space, defense and security, after raising ¥2.6 billion ($16 million).
items.summary_cn: 日本太空初创公司Letara押注其混合火箭技术可以超越小型卫星推进器，在筹集26亿日元（ 1600万美元）后，进入更广泛的太空、国防和安全市场。
items.comment: AI 领域新动态，保持关注，别被营销号带节奏。

items.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
items.summary: Anthropic forbids its Claude models from generating sexually explicit content. But a series of tests conducted by TechCrunch found that it didn't take much to get past the restriction.
items.summary_cn: Anthropic禁止其Claude模型生成色情内容。但TechCrunch进行的一系列测试发现，绕过这一限制并不需要太多时间。
items.comment: AI 模型迭代快得飞起，有几个真正解决了实际问题？等落地案例。

items.title: Show HN: OzBrain, a shared brain for knowledge between agents and your team
items.title_cn: 展示HN ： OzBrain ，代理和您的团队之间共享知识的大脑
items.summary: I think agent-first chat interfaces will be a primary software modality and busy dashboard/UI will go away. I’m not sure who exactly wins it, but I want my knowledge to grow/go with me. A lot of the “knowledge” ie research, analysis, reasoning will be done by agents as the primary user. Our current notes tools & tasks management systems were built for humans… I don’t care what the 17th thing on my bug backlog is. I want to conduct agents that can execute for me and do great work. What I built Oz
items.summary_cn: 我认为客服代表优先的聊天界面将成为主要的软件模式，繁忙的控制面板/用户界面将消失。我不确定到底是谁赢了，但我希望我的知识能与我一起成长/走向成功。许多“知识” （即研究、分析、推理）将由作为主要用户的客服代表来完成。我们目前的笔记工具和任务管理系统是为人类构建的……我不在乎我的漏洞待办列表中的第17件事是什么。我想让代理为我执行任务，做出色的工作。我为Oz打造了什么
